tasks.description: 1.1 Implement the five typed probe families with exact contract/template/context identities; verify one discrepancy and one matching control per family and document their distinguishing scope.
1.2 Reuse existing Lean application/source-goal and rational checker routes; verify failed elaboration, timeout and proof-search failure remain unresolved rather than semantic counterexamples.

1.3 Add a tiny actual separating-family theorem and an incomplete-probe counterexample fixture; verify probe agreement implies equivalence only when the exact theorem and object class match. [Accepted finite calibration](evidence/FINITE-CALIBRATION-30M-20261019/REPORT.md).
2.1 Implement bounded execution and exact-result reuse under the shared deadline; verify changed assumptions, source/environment drift and template revisions reject cached evidence.

2.2 Wire probe/inspect and sanitized reviewer export using original sources and checker receipts; verify first attempts and all failed/unsupported probes remain visible and proposed verdicts are omitted from reviewer inputs.
2.3 Run the 30-minute five-fault/five-control feasibility gate with real checker evidence; document unsupported templates and retain all attempts rather than expanding the family silently.
3.1 Verify valid domain transports and harmless method differences remain controls through investigation reporting; document application differences versus established semantic separation.
3.2 Run focused probe, checker, identity and independent-review regressions plus applicable quality checks; publish child acceptance evidence and the exact finite-agreement nonclaim.

instruction:
Recover the requested outcome and next useful result from the context files.
Work through tasks, run their completion checks, and record progress once.
Test consequential uncertain assumptions before expensive dependent work.
A failed probe stops expansion of that implementation; try a bounded alternative
within existing authorization, unchanged acceptance conditions, and the remaining
budget. Count all attempts against that budget. Keep capability tasks open until
their acceptance gates pass. Diagnose ordinary failures within scope; pause
when no viable authorized next step is available, naming the limiting dependency,
decision, or budget rather than treating one failed route as impossibility.
Report demonstrated outcomes and verification separately from checked tasks.
